faqs.question: What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ) and unit price for Custom Magnetic Interlocking Race Series Medals?
faqs.answer: The starting wholesale MOQ for Custom Magnetic Interlocking Race Series Medals is 100 pcs. Reference factory-direct tiered pricing is $3.20/pc (100 pcs starter tier), $2.15/pc (500 pcs tier), and $1.58/pc (2,000+ pcs volume tier), depending on size and finish complexity.

faqs.question: What is the mold or tooling fee for Custom Magnetic Interlocking Race Series Medals, and when is it waived?
faqs.answer: Tooling policy for Custom Magnetic Interlocking Race Series Medals is $135 Series Mold (Waived @ 1k). Every client receives custom steel tooling cut strictly to their artwork, stored free of charge for 3 years in our Zhongshan mold vault so subsequent reorders pay $0 mold fees.

faqs.question: What base materials and manufacturing crafts are used on Custom Magnetic Interlocking Race Series Medals?
faqs.answer: Custom Magnetic Interlocking Race Series Medals is custom-engineered from Zinc Alloy + N45 NdFeB Magnets using 2-to-4 Piece Puzzle Series with Alignment Magnets, sized around Ø75×4.0mm per piece at approximately 105g per unit (custom dimensions available).

faqs.question: Which electroplating colors and surface finishes are available for Custom Magnetic Interlocking Race Series Medals?
faqs.answer: Standard factory surface options for this custom craft include Gold / Silver / Copper / Black Nickel. Dual-tone masking plating and custom matte or clear protective lacquer coatings are also available upon request.

faqs.question: What backings, attachments, and accessories come with Custom Magnetic Interlocking Race Series Medals?
faqs.answer: This custom format ships with 25×850mm Matching Series Ribbon. Upgrade hardware options such as deluxe locking pin clutches, magnetic no-hole bar clasps, custom split rings, or velvet presentation boxes can be specified in your quote.

faqs.question: Can we get a free digital artwork proof before paying for tooling or samples?
faqs.answer: Yes. Send your vector logo (.AI, .EPS, .SVG, or vector .PDF) or rough sketch via our quote form or WhatsApp, and our engineering team will send a free 1:1 scaled digital production proof within 12 hours.

faqs.question: Can we order a physical pre-production sample of Custom Magnetic Interlocking Race Series Medals before mass production?
faqs.answer: Yes. Pre-production physical samples take 7–10 business days (paid sample covers custom mold cutting to your design, plating, and enamel finishing; courier air freight is billed at carrier cost or via your DHL/FedEx account).

faqs.question: What is the bulk production lead time for Custom Magnetic Interlocking Race Series Medals?
faqs.answer: Mass production for Custom Magnetic Interlocking Race Series Medals completes in 12–16 Days after digital artwork proof or physical sample approval, followed by multi-point pre-shipment inspection for color accuracy, plating luster, and attachment security.

faqs.question: Does Custom Magnetic Interlocking Race Series Medals meet US CPSIA, California Prop 65, and EU REACH safety standards?
faqs.answer: Yes. All raw metals, electroplating baths, and Pantone enamel pigments comply with US CPSIA (<90 ppm lead), California Prop 65, and EU REACH / EN 1811 nickel-release regulations.

faqs.question: What retail packaging upgrades are compatible with Custom Magnetic Interlocking Race Series Medals?
faqs.answer: Beyond complimentary individual polybags, Custom Magnetic Interlocking Race Series Medals can be packaged onto custom printed 350gsm retail backing cards, sealed inside clear acrylic coin capsules, or presented in flocked velvet gift boxes.
